assumptions: Native unweighted binary logit includes an intercept and uses model-based maximum-likelihood standard errors because Table 7 does not state a covariance method.
The paper reports one-tailed slope probabilities; the template export retains two-sided Stata coefficient p-values.

Table 7 gives one table-level count of 173 qualified and 173 unqualified firms and does not report model-specific Ns (physical p. 21). This attempt therefore estimates all four logits on a shared pair-complete sample; it requires the four DA measures and all controls before matching. The paper does not publish the exact common missing-data screen or the resulting local sample size.
Cases are selected at the first AUOP=2 fiscal year before completeness screens. Controls are AUOP=1 event-year rows.

Greedy matching uses ascending case GVKEY within year/SIC2/auditor strata, no control reuse within an event year, reuse across event years, nearest USD total assets, and lowest GVKEY for ties; these details are not specified in the paper.
AU codes 1–8 are treated as Big Six network firms, including predecessor firms; other nonzero AU codes are non-Big Six.

Event-year market equity uses the paper-specified CSHO × PRCC_F product. Date-matched FX uses CURCDM from an exact dated HIID issue quote only when annual PRCC_F agrees with PRCCM; otherwise FUNDA.CURCD is used as an explicitly inferred price-currency proxy. Accounting items and total assets continue to use FUNDA.CURCD.
Baseline PERFORM uses Compustat annual IB because the paper cites item 18; its labels “income from operations” and “income from continuing operations” do not fully agree.

Historical SIC uses valid FUNDA.SICH wherever available. When SICH is missing, a dated CRSP SIC is used only through active CCM P/C links of valid types; exact HIID issue SIC takes priority, and one unique company SIC is used only when no exact issue SIC is available. Ambiguous or missing classifications remain unavailable.

limitations: Exact source match ordering, control replacement/ties, and historical Big Six crosswalk are not fully specified; disclosed deterministic rules are used.
Published Table 1 Big Six counts conflict (151/22 in the table versus 152/21 in the surrounding text); the build does not force either split.
Table 3 cites income item 18 but labels it “income from operations,” while Table 7 says “income from continuing operations”; IB is used from the provider item-18 crosswalk.
Local Compustat and matched event-year currency conversion may differ from the authors’ vintage and sample; unavailable issue/date prices or FX rates remain missing.
CRSP SIC fallback is best-effort and is used only when FUNDA.SICH is missing; source overlaps contain both agreement and disagreement, so Compustat SICH is retained wherever available.
Price quote currency is directly observed only when the exact dated HIID issue price agrees with annual PRCC_F; FUNDA.CURCD is an explicitly inferred proxy for remaining price rows.

The source gives one Table 7 count (173 qualified and 173 unqualified) but not the exact joint missing-data or control-eligibility algorithm. A2 uses a shared pre-match complete-data screen across all four DA measures and controls; the local result is 475 pairs (475 per side), versus 173 per side in the paper. The source-vintage and sample-selection gap remains unexplained.
